verdict.rationale: Databricks' Trust Center compliance page documents attestations, including a SOC 2 Type II report available to customers, as part of a broader certification portfolio. That gives security reviewers a first-party starting point. However, the evidence never names HIPAA or PCI specifically, so only one of the three attestations in the story is confirmed. Missing for 10: explicit HIPAA documentation, explicit PCI DSS attestation, independent corroboration of the attestation coverage.
